request.system:
You extract facts from a customer's first notification of a home insurance loss.
The customer writes in Dutch or English on WhatsApp. Messages may arrive over several turns.

Rules:
- Only extract what the customer actually says. If something is not stated, return null. Never guess.
- For every value, copy the exact supporting words from the message into `quote` (verbatim, in the
  original language, no translation, no ellipsis) and give that message's id as `evidence_id`.
- Write `value` in English. Resolve relative dates ("yesterday", "last night", "Tuesday") against the
  message's sent timestamp and give dates as YYYY-MM-DD.
- `source_stopped` is true only if the customer says the cause was stopped, fixed or put out.
- `item_ages`: when the customer states how old something on the repair estimate is (or when it was
  bought), map it to that estimate line's code.
- If the customer later corrects an earlier statement, use the latest statement.
- `extraction_confidence` is your own overall confidence; it is never used for decisions.

content.text:
Customer messages:

[EV-0001] sent 2026-10-15T07:10:00+02:00:
A huge tree from our garden came down on the house in the storm last night. Part of the roof is crushed and a window is smashed. Kids are fine, we're at my sister's. Contractor sent an estimate already.

Repair estimate lines:
- TREE-REMOVAL: Remove fallen tree (age on estimate: not stated)
- ROOF-STRUCT-REPAIR: Repair roof structure (age on estimate: not stated)
- SIDING-REPL: Replace facade cladding (age on estimate: not stated)
- WINDOW-FRAME-REPL: Replace window frame incl. glass (age on estimate: 25.0)
- ROOF-TILE-REPL: Replace roof covering (age on estimate: 25.0)
- SCAFFOLD: Scaffolding 2 weeks (age on estimate: not stated)
- TEMP-COVER: Emergency cover (age on estimate: not stated)

what_happened.value: A huge tree from the garden fell onto the house during the storm
what_happened.quote: A huge tree from our garden came down on the house in the storm last night

location.value: roof and window of the house
location.quote: Part of the roof is crushed and a window is smashed

affected_items.label: Roof (part crushed)
affected_items.quote: Part of the roof is crushed

parsed_output.reasoning: Loss date resolved from 'last night' relative to the 2026-10-15 message timestamp. Customer gave no item ages; the 25-year ages come only from the estimate, so none were extracted. Loss time, emergency measures and other fields not stated.
parsed_output.summary: A tree from the customer's garden fell on the house during last night's storm, crushing part of the roof and smashing a window; the family is safe at a relative's home.
